newsitem.title: USA: Cusiana crude trades at WTI minus $1.39 a barrel.
newsitem.headline: Cusiana crude trades at WTI minus $1.39 a barrel.

text.p: Colombian state oil company Ecopetrol sold a cargo of Cusiana crude oil to a U.S. refiner for a discount of $1.39 a barrel to West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, down three cents from another deal confirmed earlier in the day, trade sources said Wednesday.
The 550,000 barrel cargo loads July 6-10, making it the the first July cargo to change hands.
Ecopetrol is also seeking bids for another Cusiana cargo loading July 15-19. --Patricia Garip-Bertuol NY Energy Desk ((+1 212 859 1620))
